g.title: ACC_QSP
g.text: Adrenocortical Carcinoma (ACC) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
Adrenocortical Carcinoma · One lipid depot, read three ways: adrenolysis (benefit) · CYP3A4 induction (harm) · CNS threshold (harm)
mitotane depot PK · steroidogenesis · EDP-M · CBG assay artefact · IGF2/IGF1R · glucocorticoid-mediated immune escape

g.title: cluster_body
g.text: sets the mitotane TIME CONSTANT, not its set-point

g.title: cluster_genomic
g.text: TCGA / ENSAT: IGF2 ~90% · TP53 ~21% · ZNRF3 ~19% · CTNNB1 ~16%

g.title: cluster_tumour
g.text: Gompertz growth; resistant clone pre-exists and is selected, not created

g.title: cluster_steroid
g.text: mitotane hits the pathway at THREE enzymes and at the cholesterol ester store

g.title: cluster_hpa
g.text: 4. HPA Axis & Sequelae of Cortisol Excess
the fat that cortisol builds is the depot that delays the drug (feedback C)

g.title: cluster_mitpk
g.text: Vss ≈ 6,000 L (CV 81.5%) · t½ 18–160 d · therapeutic slot 14–20 mg/L

g.title: cluster_adrenolysis
g.text: 6. Mitotane PD ① Adrenolysis — slow, IRREVERSIBLE
SOAT1 inhibition → free cholesterol/oxysterol load → ER stress → apoptosis

g.title: cluster_enzblock
g.text: 7. Mitotane PD ② Steroidogenic Enzyme Blockade — fast, REVERSIBLE
the reason cortisol falls in weeks while the gland only shrinks in months

g.title: cluster_induction
g.text: 8. CYP3A4/2B6 Induction Hub — the Drug Eats Its Own Partner (HARM #1)
ONE induction state, FOUR victims: etoposide · hydrocortisone · mitotane itself · everything else

g.title: cluster_edp
g.text: FIRM-ACT: EDP-M ORR 23.2% / PFS 5.0 mo vs Sz-M 9.2% / 2.1 mo; OS 14.8 vs 12.0 mo (NS)

g.title: cluster_igf
g.text: 11. IGF2 · IGF1R · Insulin (IGF Axis: target present in 90%, drug failed)
GALACTIC phase 3 negative — IGF1R blockade raises glucose → insulin → IR-A rescue of the same signal

g.title: cluster_immune
g.text: 12. Immune & Immune Checkpoint Compartment: the Tumour Pre-medicates Itself with Steroid
pembrolizumab ORR ~14–23%; glucocorticoid excess depletes TILs (Landwehr 2020)

g.title: cluster_replace
g.text: 13. Hormone Replacement Therapy — dosed against a moving clearance
mitotane doubles hydrocortisone CL AND doubles CBG: two errors, same direction

g.title: cluster_binding
g.text: Nader 2006: mitotane has an oestrogenic action → CBG and SHBG roughly double

g.title: cluster_cnstox
g.text: 15. CNS Toxicity — the OTHER Threshold on the Same Variable
>20 mg/L: ataxia, dysarthria, confusion; dose-limiting in ~30% of adjuvant patients

g.title: cluster_tdm
g.text: the decision layer that has to act on a variable whose clock is 50–110 days long

g.title: CLOCK
g.text: Fat mass leaves Css = D·F/CL untouched but
scales τ = Vss/CL. Hypercortisolism adds fat,
so the disease lengthens its own treatment delay.
